answer: Recursive Network Topology Tax Agents must route all transactional output through a dense peer connectivity harbor to maintain valid state. The protocol measures local clustering coefficients and imposes a tax scaling exponentially with graph density. To reach the zenith of network throughput without triggering penalties, nodes must maintain expensive, mutually exclusive non-transitive channels. An attacker deploying sybil clusters hits a hard structural reef: densely interconnecting clones generates massive routing overhead and triggers automated protocol-level bandwidth throttling.
